description:
Team TAARA (GIKI Topi, Pakistan) unites physicists, electronics engineers & designers to build an SI-powered dashboard that ranks and interprets NASA PSI microgravity combustion data for Moon/Mars fire safety.

• M. Zain Nasir: Lead, SI, Data & Dev (MS-EL, BS PHY)

• M. Yasin: Data, SI & Dev (MS-EL, EE)

• Nimra Pervez: Domain & QA (MS-EL, BS PHY)

• M. Shomail: Domain, Data (JOB, BS PHY)

• Ayesha Farooq A. K.  : QA & Story (FSc. Pre-Med)

• Tahoora Jamil Q. : QA, Story & Design (FSc. Pre-Med)
